description: Fire heroes focus on aggressive playstyles with high ATK, burst damage abilities, and low-to-moderate DEF. Visual theme: red/orange/yellow flames, ember VFX, volcanic aesthetics.

cards.name: Aria, Flame Knight

abilities.name: Blazing Strike
abilities.description: Deal 70 damage to target enemy. Splash 20 damage to adjacent enemies.

abilities.name: Inferno Aura
abilities.description: All Fire units gain +15% ATK (Phase 2 feature - deferred).

cards.lore: A legendary warrior who commands the eternal flames of the Ashen Citadel. Aria's blade has never been extinguished, burning brighter with each victory.
cards.designNotes: Starter Fire hero. High ATK, low DEF = glass cannon aggro. Blazing Strike is AOE burst (good vs clustered enemies). Use early-game to establish board control.

cards.name: Ragnar, Inferno Berserker

abilities.name: Rage Strike
abilities.description: Deal 60 damage. If this kills the target, Ragnar gains +20 ATK for 2 turns.

abilities.name: Berserker Fury
abilities.description: When below 30% HP, gain +30% ATK and +1 Move.

cards.lore: A wild warrior from the Ember Wastes who grows stronger as battle rages. Ragnar's fury knows no bounds when blood is spilled.
cards.designNotes: Budget aggressive hero (4 points vs Aria's 8). High risk/reward - low HP triggers Berserker Fury for massive damage spike. Rage Strike snowballs if enemies die easily.

cards.name: Cinder, Flame Mage

abilities.name: Flame Bolt
abilities.description: Deal 40 damage to target enemy (3-range). Can target flying units.

abilities.name: Arcane Flow
abilities.description: Restore 10 Mana at start of each turn.

cards.lore: A young pyromancer studying the ancient arts of fire magic. Cinder's spells are precise and deadly at range.
cards.designNotes: Budget ranged hero (1 point). High Mana pool + regen = spam Flame Bolt every turn. Low HP = vulnerable to melee rush. Good for backline support in aggro decks.

cards.name: Blaze, Dragon Rider

abilities.name: Dragon Breath
abilities.description: Deal 100 damage in a 3-tile cone. Ignores 50% of enemy DEF.

abilities.name: Flying Mastery
abilities.description: Immune to melee attacks from non-flying units. Can move through enemy units.

cards.lore: The last of the Dragon Riders, bonded to Pyrothos the Eternal Flame. Together they soar above battlefields, raining devastation from the skies.
cards.designNotes: Endgame Fire hero (16 points = 20% of Level 20 budget). Flying = immune to melee, Dragon Breath = massive AOE burst. Counter: ranged units, dispel abilities (Phase 2). Limited uses (3× per battle) prevents spam.

cards.name: Ember, Phoenix Guardian

abilities.name: Phoenix Rebirth
abilities.description: When Ember dies, revive at 50% HP at the start of next turn. Can only trigger once per battle.

abilities.name: Healing Flames
abilities.description: Restore 30 HP to target ally. If target is Fire element, restore 50 HP instead.

cards.lore: Bonded with the eternal phoenix spirit, Ember serves as guardian of the Flame Temple. Her power over life and fire is unmatched.
cards.designNotes: Support-oriented Fire hero (rare archetype for Fire). Phoenix Rebirth is a one-time cheat death (prevents all-in aggro loss). Healing Flames offers sustain for long battles. Good for midrange/control Fire decks.
